verdict.rationale: Phaser is a 2D web game framework; its documented asset pipeline covers images, texture atlases, sprite sheets, fonts, audio and JSON (phaser-docs-10, phaser-docs-36, phaser-docs-47), with no mention of 3D interchange formats. glTF/FBX/USD import is a 3D-asset-pipeline concern that doesn't apply to a 2D-only engine's category.
